item.apprenticecodex.focus_staffbow.loan: Mana loan is being repaid, so focused casting is unavailable.

item.apprenticecodex.element_maiden_robe: This armor is affected by the equipped spellbook.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_agent_suit.run: Tune this armor's school at a Spell Calibration Bench.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_agent_suit_hoo: Spellgun and Staffrifle Ammo has a chance not to be consumed.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_agent_suit_coa: Changes SpellPower school bonuses for certain attack spells to this armor's tuned school.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_agent_suit_leg: Negates casting movement slowdown for certain attack spells and prevents their casts from being interrupted.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_agent_suit_boo: Reduces cooldowns and cast times for certain attack spells.

item.apprenticecodex.mana_force_blade.de: Hold use to guard, spending mana to block attacks.
Supports Epic Fight guard skills like an uchigatana, and can spend mana to deflect arrows even with a normal guard.
Imbue a spell to attune this blade to its school and increase attack damage.
item.apprenticecodex.spell_side_edge.des: Can borrow spellcasting-related main-hand bonuses from the item held in your offhand.
While held in the main hand, this dagger prevents offhand attacks.
item.apprenticecodex.spell_side_edge_mir: Pairs with a main-hand Spell-Sided Edge to attack as dual blades.
item.apprenticecodex.arcane_spellcaster_: Ammo for slightly complex instant casting spells
item.apprenticecodex.arcane_propellant_c: A propellant charge used for spellcaster rounds
item.apprenticecodex.spell_bullet_head.d: A bullet head used for spellcaster rounds
item.apprenticecodex.spell_bullet_mold.d: A mold used by a Deployer
item.apprenticecodex.spell_casing_mold.d: A mold used by a Deployer
item.apprenticecodex.scarlet_thirst.desc: Converts excess health into mana when mana is low.
Enhances specific utility spells and can cast utility spells efficiency.
Use while crouching to seal magic power.
item.apprenticecodex.zenith_staff.desc_1: Casts every school as though it had a %s%% school power bonus.
item.apprenticecodex.zenith_staff.no_bon: This staff awakens while you have a school power bonus.
item.apprenticecodex.protection_spell_su: Enhances specific defensive spells and boosts mana efficiency.
item.apprenticecodex.absorption_amplify_: Generate an absorption shield that automatically recovers to a certain value.
With your current equipment, it refills up to %s HP.
The recovery amount is amplified by the strength of holy school.
Removing this accessory causes loses all absorption shields.
item.apprenticecodex.spellcaster_ammo_po: Increase chance of returning empty casing.
Can store and automatically use cartridges even without equipping.
Drawing certain bows no longer slows you down.
Can store arrows even without equipping, and certain bows can use them automatically.
item.apprenticecodex.autocast_amulet.des: However, it keeps trying to cast regardless of the situation.
It can cast fewer spells, but considers the situation to some extent.
item.apprenticecodex.satellite_followcas: Casts imbued spells alongside your own spellcasting.
When multiple spells are imbued, it tries to cast them in order.
item.apprenticecodex.mana_shield_charm.d: Absorbs damage by consuming %s mana per damage.
Mana barrier does not benefit from armor.
Stops functioning until mana recovers to %d after depletion.
item.apprenticecodex.mana_thruster.desc_: Hold [%s] while airborne to consume mana and accelerate upward.
Once activated, mana regeneration stops until you land.
This thruster itself does not grant fall damage immunity.
item.apprenticecodex.jumpcast_charm.desc: Press [%s] while airborne casts the imbued spell.
item.apprenticecodex.spell_cast_parrying: For a brief moment right after casting begins, you can parry attacks from the front.
Spells with no cast time or spells that require continuous casting are excluded.
item.apprenticecodex.magi_compressor_gad: Consumes mana to store a small amount of compressed air.
Can also supply equipment that requires compressed air.
item.apprenticecodex.swingcast.common.de: This staff casts its imbued spell with each full swing.
item.apprenticecodex.freecast.common.des: This item casts the selected spell with each full swing.

item.apprenticecodex.multipurpose_staffr: Aim with [%1$s] to enable rapid fire.
item.apprenticecodex.smashcast_scepter.d: Smashes on falling attack hits. If the imbued spell can be cast, it is empowered by fall distance and cast.
Falling attack hits negate fall damage regardless of whether the spell casts.
item.apprenticecodex.scrollcaster_gauntl: When casting from the gauntlet with [%1$s], it always casts the spell selected on this gauntlet.
This gauntlet is tuned to the "%s" school.

item.apprenticecodex.bound_weapon.contai: Let go of the weapon to restore the item inside.
item.apprenticecodex.spell_invoke_card.d: Throw it to cast the imbued spell where it lands.
item.apprenticecodex.spell_autonomy_card: Throw it to make it hover in the air, then cast the imbued spell after a delay.
jei.apprenticecodex.arcane_cinder.desc_1: Using it as fuel in a furnace, blast furnace, or smoker increases processing speed.
jei.apprenticecodex.arcane_cinder.desc_2: It has no effect in other machines.
jei.apprenticecodex.arcanum_in_a_jar.des: Place it and supply redstone to slowly convert it into Arcane Essence over time.
Breaking it drops any finished Arcane Essence and any unused redstone.
jei.apprenticecodex.spellcaster_workbenc: A workbench for crafting spellgun rounds.
It can also partially adjust Spellcaster's Flasks and upgrade specific items.
Check JEI for craftable items and items that can be upgraded.
jei.apprenticecodex.atelier_station.desc: Extracts potions from 2 blocks away from an Alchemist's Cauldron and refills Flask remotely.
jei.apprenticecodex.spell_dispenser.desc: Set a scroll inside to have redstone cast the spell for you.
Usable scrolls are restricted; place a scroll to check whether it can be used.
To cast spells, refill the dispenser's mana with mana potions.
Continuous-cast spells persist while redstone input is active, and the input must be cut once before they can be cast again.
jei.apprenticecodex.creative_spell_dispe: A special Spell Dispenser tuned for builders from the standard Spell Dispenser.
It differs from the standard version as follows:
- Does not retain any information about the player who placed it.
- Uses a different configuration from the standard version, with default cooldown set to 10%.
- Drops nothing when broken in Survival, including its contents.
- Does not notify Survival players with permission level 1 or lower about errors.
- Survival players with permission level 1 or lower cannot access its inventory.
jei.apprenticecodex.craftsmans_delight.d: The spells listed in the tooltip gain the following effects:
- Block-breaking spells gain ring enchantments and increased breaking speed.
- Item-processing spells can process more items at once.
- Casting no longer reduces movement speed.
In addition, the following spells gain extra effects:
- Tiny Lumberjack: Drops from chopped blocks are aggregated to one place.
- World Flatter: Block-breaking power increases from iron-tier to netherite-tier.
- Heavenly Fist: Harvests mature crystals growing from nearby budding blocks.
- Mana Mending: Resets the item's cumulative anvil work count when repair completes.
- Graced Rain: Growth acceleration also affects creatures and helps them breed again sooner.
jei.apprenticecodex.protection_spell_sup: Modifies the spells below and reduces their mana cost while they are active.
- Force Field: Can block attacks that a shield cannot.
- Phalanx Charge: Increases movement speed while guarding with the shield, and can neutralize Counterspell from the front.
- Mystic Shield: Increases damage of reflected projectiles.
Spellcasting aids meant to be used in your offhand.
When your main hand holds a weapon or tool without a special use action, you can use these from your offhand-like a staff-to cast spells.
Additionally, you can gain ability bonuses and cast imbued spell when you need to use two-handed weapons.
jei.apprenticecodex.autocast_amulet.desc: Set scrolls on the Spell Calibration Bench, and it will keep automatically casting those configured spells.
By default, it ignores the situation entirely and attempts to cast whenever the spell is not on cooldown.
Items can be inserted on the Spell Calibration Bench to tune the amulet. Their effects are listed below.
- Slot upgrade items: Increase the amulet's scroll slots by 1.
- Silver Ring: Allows spells that require casting time to activate with no cast time. Continuous-cast spells are still not allowed.
- Wisdom Shard: Greatly limits which spells can autocast, but makes it consider the situation to some extent. Mostly supports buff and self-healing spells.
jei.apprenticecodex.satellite_followcast: Set scrolls with a Spell Calibration Bench to have the amulet cast alongside your own spellcasting.
Set spells are not fired simultaneously; it tries to activate them in the order their scrolls were set.
Because it consumes mana, activation fails if there is not enough mana left after the wearer's spell casts.
Insert items at a Spell Calibration Bench to adjust the amulet. Each effect is listed below.
- Slot Upgrade Item: Increases the amulet's scroll slots by 1.
- Silver Ring: Spells that require casting can be fired without cast time, and continuous-cast spells can be maintained for a fixed duration.
jei.apprenticecodex.spellgun_items.desc_: Spellguns cast spells using special cartridges instead of the user's mana.
The material used to craft one greatly changes which spells it can accept, and the imbue restrictions are strict.
They can be used from your non-main hand, but you will not receive the performance benefits of the Spellgun.
The spells they can accept can be checked in item details and JEI.
jei.apprenticecodex.swingcast_staves.des: Staves that cast their imbued spell when swung in the main hand.
The spells they can accept vary greatly by material.
The spells they can accept can be checked in item details and JEI.
jei.apprenticecodex.mithril_freecast_sta: A staff that can cast the selected spell when swung from the main hand.
Unlike Swingcast Staffs, it cannot be imbued with spells.
Insert items at a Spell Calibration Bench to adjust the staff. The effects are listed below.
- School Rune: Changes the spell power bonus from general spell power to that rune's school.
- Silver Ring: Allows spells that require cast time to be cast instantly. Spells that require continuous casting are still unsupported.
jei.apprenticecodex.revolvercast_staff.d: A staff that swing-casts spells loaded at a Spell Calibration Bench.
It has strict spell restrictions, but can switch the spell it casts each time it is swung.
Unlike other Swingcast Staffs, it cannot be imbued at an Arcane Anvil. Load multiple spell scrolls at a Spell Calibration Bench instead.
The following adjustment items are available:
- Slot upgrade items: Increase the staff's scroll slots by 2.
- School Rune: Changes the spell power bonus from general spell power to that rune's school.
- Recovery Rune: If swing-casting fails, the staff advances to the next loaded spell instead of staying on the current one.
- Silver Ring: Allows spells that require cast time to be cast instantly. Spells that require continuous casting are still unsupported.
Accepted spells can be checked in item details and JEI.
jei.apprenticecodex.ender_grimoire.desc_: A spellbook that accepts scrolls when used in hand, instead of being inscribed at an Inscription Table.
Scrolls placed inside are stored in each player's personal inventory, like an Ender Chest.
Even if you lose the Ender Grimoire itself, getting a new one lets you keep using the spells stored inside.
jei.apprenticecodex.spellstained_runic_t: A spellbook whose performance is improved by scrolls inscribed into it at an Inscription Table.
By default it grants no bonuses, but inscribing scrolls changes its stats as follows:
- Rarity increases max mana and spell power.
- Spell power for the inscribed scrolls' schools increases based on rarity.
- Inscribing scrolls from many schools reduces cooldown.
- Inscribing many scrolls from the same school reduces cast time based on the highest count.
By default, school spell power totals only apply when they reach +5% or -5%.
A spellbook that accepts scrolls when used in hand, instead of being inscribed at an Inscription Table.
Not every stored spell can be used at once; only up to 9 slots, the same as one inventory row, are available at a time.
With the spell selection screen open, use the mouse wheel to switch which inventory row is active.
Only part of its inventory is available at first, and it must be expanded at a Spellcaster Workbench.
jei.apprenticecodex.focus_staffbow.desc_: Use it in the main hand to charge up spells before casting them.
Spells can be charged up to 3x, or 2x for continuous-cast spells, but the mana cost rises sharply.
You can cast even if the mana cost exceeds your current mana, but the staff will keep draining mana until the shortage is repaid, and charged casting cannot be used during that time.
jei.apprenticecodex.spellcharged_greatsw: Cast spells while holding it to store magical residue in the blade based on each spell's cooldown.
As residue builds up, the sword shifts toward heavier swings with stronger performance.
When enough residue is stored, hold right-click and release to temporarily shift the sword toward lighter, wider sweeping attacks.
Residue fades while you are not casting spells, and extremely short-cooldown spells generate very little residue.
jei.apprenticecodex.circuit_heat_staff.d: Use it in the main hand to force-cast spells by ignoring their cooldown.
Casting while ignoring cooldown greatly increases mana cost. If that cost exceeds your current mana, the staff overheats and stops working for a while.
The added mana cost is calculated from the cooldown time being ignored and the number of consecutive forced casts.
Submerging a disabled staff in water or powder snow speeds up its recovery.
jei.apprenticecodex.elemental_bow.desc_1: Sneak while holding it to switch modes and fire a variety of arrows.
jei.apprenticecodex.elemental_bow.desc_2: It can also fire arrows that cast spells by consuming arrows. These can be fired rapidly by ignoring cooldown, but their mana cost keeps rising.
jei.apprenticecodex.elemental_bow.desc_3: Spell-casting arrows are not affected by Infinity and require the Synthesis enchantment.
jei.apprenticecodex.reflectcast_shield.d: A lightweight shield that can be raised instantly.
If you block an attack immediately after raising it, the imbued spell is cast instantly without consuming mana.
However, when the shield is glowing red, the spell is still on cooldown and will not activate even if the block succeeds.
The spells it can accept can be checked in item details and JEI.
jei.apprenticecodex.multipurpose_staffri: A gun-shaped staff that uses dedicated rounds to cast the selected spell without imbuing it.
Unlike spellguns, it consumes both mana and rounds, but aiming enables rapid consecutive casts.
Its delicate mechanism prevents melee use, and empty casings are rarely returned.
jei.apprenticecodex.smashcast_scepter.de: A scepter that casts its imbued spell with amplified spell power when swung downward from a height.
Landing a falling smash attack also boosts the scepter's own attack damage and negates fall damage.
The spells it can accept can be checked in item details and JEI.
jei.apprenticecodex.scrollcaster_gauntle: A gauntlet that lets you load scrolls and switch between multiple spells separately from spellbooks.
Set scrolls and adjustment items at a Spell Calibration Bench first. While holding the gauntlet, sneak to switch between loaded scrolls.
It cannot be enchanted through normal methods.
The following adjustment items are available:
- Slot upgrade items: Increase the gauntlet's scroll slots by 2.
- School Rune: Changes the spell power bonus from general spell power to that rune's school.
- Enchantment book items: Applies the first enchantment listed on the item to the gauntlet.
- Mithril Freecast Staff: Lets the gauntlet swing-cast the selected spell like a Mithril Freecast Staff. A Silver Ring adjustment also applies.
Only one mutually incompatible enchantment is applied; enchantments for swords, pickaxes, or spellcasting aids are supported.
jei.apprenticecodex.spell_calibration_be: A workstation for adjusting some equipment's performance with adjustment items and configuring imbued spells.
It cannot handle items whose imbued spells cannot be removed; use an Arcane Anvil for those.
jei.apprenticecodex.spell_throwable_card: Imbue a spell and throw the card to cast it remotely with behavior specific to each card type.
Cards are consumable, but they can be crafted without consuming the scroll used for imbuing.
Accepted spells are restricted by configuration and can be checked in item details and JEI.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.tense.desc: Reduces spell cast time. Channeled spells take longer to cast.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.surge.desc: Increases spell power for all elements.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.attunement.d: Increases spell power for the imbued element.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.transcendenc: Only while held, increases the level of the imbued spell.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.wisdom.desc: Mobs and minerals will drop more experience when killed or mined.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.plunder.desc: Mobs will drop more drop when killed with magic weapons.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.red_energy.d: Increases duration of effects in flask.
Increases potency of effects in flask but reduces the duration.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.shell.desc: Mana Barrier gains the defense value of the wearer's armor, but the armor will be damaged when the wearer is hit.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.synchronizat: Mana Barrier gains the effects of the enchantments on the wearer's armor, but mana consumption increases.
enchantment.apprenticecodex.neutralizati: When Mana Barrier takes an attack that ignores defense, it completely nullifies the attack and absorbs it as mana instead.

skill.apprenticecodex.wind_leap.tooltip: Leap high enough to prepare a smash, then strike just before landing. The leap itself does not protect you from falling.
spell.apprenticecodex.sky_edge.guide: Summons a weapon that fires toward your line of sight. It has a wind-up and deals no knockback, but it can ignore the target's invulnerability frames.
spell.apprenticecodex.archer_multiple.gu: Summons a magical bow that follows you and keeps firing until it runs out of shots, prioritizing your chosen target or nearby enemies.
spell.apprenticecodex.commence_fire.guid: Summons a magical rifle that follows you. Use it again to unleash a powerful shot.
spell.apprenticecodex.compound_phial.gui: Instantly brews a potion on the spot and hurls it. It bypasses armor, but it can hit you as well.
spell.apprenticecodex.quick_arms.guide: Summons a magical handgun and lets you fire it rapidly for a short time.
spell.apprenticecodex.breaching_enemy.gu: Summons a magical shotgun and fires. Its range is short, but the knockback is extremely powerful.
spell.apprenticecodex.bullet_stream.guid: Summons a magical gatling gun and keeps firing. It deals no knockback, but it can ignore the target's invulnerability frames.
spell.apprenticecodex.arcane_blast.guide: Detonates arcane power inside the target and accelerates your mana circulation. As an arcane attack, it bypasses armor, but it is powerless against demonic beings. A replica of the Weaver Mage's spell.
spell.apprenticecodex.arcane_beam.guide: Continuously projects piercing arcane particles in a straight line. Consuming circulated mana greatly boosts its performance. As an arcane attack, it bypasses armor, but it is powerless against demonic beings. A replica of the Weaver Mage's spell.
spell.apprenticecodex.tiny_lumberjack.gu: Summons a magical circular saw and shreds the target in your line of sight. Swing it at a tree to fell it as well.
spell.apprenticecodex.graced_rain.guide: Summons a rain cloud with healing power, restoring the life of those beneath it. The healing also nourishes vegetation.
spell.apprenticecodex.mage_light.guide: Summons and places a magical torch that lights up the area. The torch does not require a supporting block.
spell.apprenticecodex.personal_shelf.gui: Materializes a magical vault for a limited time. It vanishes after a while or if you move away. The vault is merely an interface to each person's private space. Use while sneaking to attempt to transfer its contents to a chest or similar container.
spell.apprenticecodex.rift_hole.guide: Open an otherworldly hole on a block face and carve a temporary tunnel through the wall. Cast it again, or wait a short while, to seal the passage.
spell.apprenticecodex.fly_swatter.guide: Summons a magical launcher that attacks a target you lock onto in your line of sight. Its shots home in on the enemy.
spell.apprenticecodex.assist_wings.guide: Summons magical wings and leaps with a flap. It can also be activated midair a limited number of times based on your mana. After use, you gain Slow Falling until you land and take no fall damage. If you are holding a weapon that uses falling, the wings automatically collapse right after the leap, allowing you to take fall damage.
spell.apprenticecodex.world_flatter.guid: Summons a magical drill that pierces the target in your line of sight through their armor. Swing it into the ground to quickly carve out a large hole.
spell.apprenticecodex.slash_blade.guide: Summons a magical katana and delivers a swift slash in front of you. The cast cannot be interrupted.
spell.apprenticecodex.manifestation_grim: Summons a grimoire linked to the caster's domain. Spells stored within it can be used from any grimoire called forth by this spell.
spell.apprenticecodex.feather_rush.guide: Summons magical wings and beats them to scatter countless feathers. While flapping, you do not fall.
spell.apprenticecodex.mantis_leap.guide: Summons a pair of magical blades and leaps toward your line of sight to shred the target. The cast cannot be interrupted, and you take no knockback while leaping.
spell.apprenticecodex.palette_shift.guid: A latent spell unique to the Pastel Staff. It dyes the staff with the next spell you cast. This spell cannot dye the staff on its own.
spell.apprenticecodex.phalanx_charge.gui: Summons a magical spear and shield and immediately assumes a guarding stance. When the stance ends, you thrust sharply forward. The cast cannot be interrupted.
spell.apprenticecodex.higanbana.guide: Summons a cursed magical blade. Use it again to unleash a flurry of strikes. Its damage is low, but it heals you for 100% of the damage dealt.
spell.apprenticecodex.thermal_process.gu: Summons a magical flamethrower to sear whatever lies in your line of sight. Keeping the heat on a target applies an intense heat effect. You can also beam it at smeltable items to process them. It will not set the surroundings—or anything unrelated—on fire.
spell.apprenticecodex.earth_forge.guide: Creates a flat patch of dirt blocks at your line of sight. While sneaking, the area is reduced to a single block.
spell.apprenticecodex.moon_light.guide: Summons a katana from beyond the laws of this world and delivers a single flash-cut. The blade's moonlit power then rends space—sharp and deep. The cast cannot be interrupted.
spell.apprenticecodex.mana_mending.guide: Channels your mana into a damaged item in your hands to repair it. If both hands hold items, the offhand is preferred. You cannot cast it unless you are directly holding a damaged item.
spell.apprenticecodex.mana_slash.guide: A latent spell unique to the Crystal Bladed Staff. Launches a blade of condensed mana. Its damage scales with the staff's attack damage. On hit, it creates orbs that restore mana.
spell.apprenticecodex.force_field.guide: Deploys an invisible field that repels enemy attacks from any direction. It consumes a large amount of mana when it knocks something away, but it can also repel certain spells. An imitation of the magic used by a long-lived race from another realm.
spell.apprenticecodex.precision_jack.gui: Summon a magical knife to cleave your target. Expect a lot more drops than usual, but you need to rotate a significant number of times before it can be activated.
spell.apprenticecodex.auto_magnet.guide: Summon a magical magnet to follow you. The magnet collects nearby items and experience orbs and transfers them to you. Item collection stops while your inventory is full. While in normal mode, sneaking temporarily stops collection; cast while sneaking to switch to reverse mode, where it collects only while you are sneaking.
spell.apprenticecodex.grind_runner.guide: Summons an arcane wheel to grind down whatever is in front of you. It can grind not only mobs, but also certain items. Release your magic to launch the wheel. When the laws of gears are present (Create installed), item grinding is handled as if processed by Crushing Wheels or a Millstone.
spell.apprenticecodex.remote_eye.guide: Detach your vision and freely move your gaze for a certain period of time. You cannot pass through walls, and you are defenseless during the effect period.
spell.apprenticecodex.sense_evil.guide: Detects nearby unholy beings and highlights them in your vision. It can sense them even without a clear line of sight, and can also detect devices that create such unholy entities.
spell.apprenticecodex.deep_sensor.guide: For a time, grants heightened perception of the distinctive sounds of the Abyss.
spell.apprenticecodex.long_stride.guide: While casting, you can move faster and can jump over small obstacles.
spell.apprenticecodex.spectral_wing.guid: Launches you into the air with mana wings and immediately transitions into a glide. Recast while flying to surge hard in the direction you are looking. The wings vanish when you land or touch water.
spell.apprenticecodex.auto_turret.guide: Summons a crossbow that automatically attacks nearby enemies. It disappears shortly after running out of ammo, or when its durability runs out. Before it disappears, right-click the crossbow to spend a small amount of mana and refill its ammo to maximum.
spell.apprenticecodex.illuminate_stellar: A latent spell unique to the Illuminate Stellar Staff. By waving it, spreads twinkling stars and flies towards entities with malevolent intent.
spell.apprenticecodex.unite_luna.guide: A latent spell unique to the Unite Luna Staff. By waving it, creates a crescent moon and obliterates disturbing entities. If someone tries to negate its magic, it turns that force into greater power.
Place a demi-creator core at your current position and gain creative flight only while you remain inside its area. Recast it, let the timer expire, or leave the area to dismiss the wings.
spell.apprenticecodex.companion_trunk.gu: Summon an arcane chest to follow you. It can hold about as many items as a normal chest, can be recalled to your side even while loaded if it is far enough away, and tries to stash its contents into a chest when it vanishes.
spell.apprenticecodex.linear_build.guide: Places blocks held in either hand in a straight line from the targeted face until just before it crosses your matching coordinate axis. You cannot cast it unless either hand holds a block, and if the targeted block has direction or shape, it tries to copy it as closely as possible. The offhand block is preferred, and matching blocks are consumed from sources other than your hands first. It can also retrieve blocks from your linked Personal Shelf and Ender Chest, your nearby Toolbox and pets, equipped backpacks, and Shulker Boxes or Bundles you are carrying.
spell.apprenticecodex.treasure_divinatio: Focus your mana to learn how far away the nearest valuable-looking thing is. It may not actually be valuable, and what it can detect is limited.
spell.apprenticecodex.healing_bloom.guid: Summons a magical flower that softly lights the area around it. Staying near it grants healing, and over time it grows Comfort Berries. Each caster can maintain only one at a time; cast while sneaking to replace your previous bloom.
spell.apprenticecodex.search_beacon.guid: Summon a magical brazier that searches for different structures depending on the item you offer it. If it finds anything, it points the way with glowing markers. If it finds nothing, some of the offered items may be returned. Eligible items are closely tied to magic schools.
spell.apprenticecodex.tamers_pocket.guid: Stores one of your tamed pets from your line of sight or the surrounding area inside a personal magical domain. If no tamed pet is in sight but you already have one stored, it is brought out near you instead. While stored, pets inside recover naturally, though only very slowly.
spell.apprenticecodex.harvest_moon.guide: Harvest crops around you without destroying them and bringing them to you.
spell.apprenticecodex.shock.guide: Shot lightning bolt converted from elemental energy.
spell.apprenticecodex.extract.guide: Extract contents from Alchemist's Flask in your hand and throw it as a potion. Effectiveness, splash or lingering depends on what is extracted.
spell.apprenticecodex.silent_assassin.gu: Summons a magical sniper rifle that self-destructs after one shot, then aims and fires. It deals extremely high damage to mobs that have not noticed you.
spell.apprenticecodex.tiro_volley.guide: Summons magical muskets one after another around you, continuously attacking nearby enemies. A replica of the magic used by a magical girl who overcame her fear.
spell.apprenticecodex.bound_sword.guide: Temporarily forges a magical sword in your hand. It is lighter than an ordinary sword, allowing quicker attacks. The weapon held when it is forged is temporarily sealed inside the sword, and returns to your hand when the sword collapses after being released. If the laws of combat are present, it attempts to forge the sword for dual wielding. It cannot exist at the same time as another bound weapon. When a Greater Conjurer's Talisman is equipped, dismissing the bound weapon never puts the spell on cooldown, regardless of conditions.
spell.apprenticecodex.bound_bow.guide: Temporarily forges a magical bow in your hand. Even when you have no arrows, it can consume mana to forge and fire a normal arrow. The weapon held when it is forged is temporarily sealed inside the bow, and returns to your hand when the bow collapses after being released. It cannot exist at the same time as another bound weapon. When a Greater Conjurer's Talisman is equipped, dismissing the bound weapon never puts the spell on cooldown, regardless of conditions.
spell.apprenticecodex.magic_spear.guide: Summons and launches a magical spear that flies toward the target in your line of sight. It bursts on impact, catching nearby targets in the blast. A replica of the weapon once wielded by an angel who ruled the skies.
spell.apprenticecodex.frost_rune.guide: Carves a frost rune into terrain. It detonates when touched by anything other than its caster, attacking targets in range. Concealment magic makes it hard to see, but it cannot fool the Jade Eye at all.
spell.apprenticecodex.mystic_shield.guid: Deploys a magical barrier that absorbs attacks. It only blocks attacks from the front, but when the barrier is released, it fires a counterattack projectile based on the absorbed attacks.
spell.apprenticecodex.echo_cast.guide: A latent spell unique to the Multicast Echo Staff. It echoes mana, causing the next spell cast with this staff to trigger multiple times. Echoing this spell itself increases the count.
spell.apprenticecodex.mist_form.guide: Transforms you into a mist-like state and briefly distracts enemies. While in mist form, your mobility improves slightly and you can pass through some blocks. Attacking can destabilize the mist and may cancel the form, and you become extremely vulnerable to fire and holy spells.
spell.apprenticecodex.inscribe_ice.guide: Creates ice daggers and throws them in a fan, inscribing ice magic into mobs they damage. On the third successful inscription, the magic bursts for heavy damage. This burst can trigger nearby inscribed ice magic in turn.
spell.apprenticecodex.edge_dancer.guide: A latent spell unique to the Spell-Sided Edge. Copies your main-hand blade into your offhand. The item held in that hand during copying is temporarily sealed inside the blade, and returns to your hand when the blade collapses after being released. If no laws of combat are present, it functions as combat support, allowing attacks from the main-hand blade to ignore invulnerability frames. It cannot exist at the same time as another bound weapon. When a Greater Conjurer's Talisman is equipped, dismissing the copy never puts the spell on cooldown, regardless of conditions.
spell.apprenticecodex.anchor_blink.guide: A latent spell unique to the Spell-Sided Reverse Edge. Throws the offhand dagger forward to attack. If you are holding jump when it sticks into something, or press jump within 3 seconds afterward, you teleport near the stuck dagger. Throwing the dagger ends Edge Dancer.
A latent spell unique to the Maiden of the Elements Robe. It invites an elemental being into your body, causing your strongest school bonus to apply to every other school for a limited time. You must wear the full Maiden of the Elements outfit to let such a being descend into you.
spell.apprenticecodex.heavenly_fist.guid: Summons an amethyst arcane fist at the targeted location and slams the space itself. Targets in the area are knocked down to the ground for a short time. When the laws of gears are present (Create installed), it attempts to process items by pressing or compacting, limited to near the fist's impact.
spell.apprenticecodex.mirage_avoidance.g: For a brief moment after activation, evade all damage and glide in the direction you are moving. You can fine-tune the glide direction by turning your body. Spell level and spell power do not change the travel distance. A replica of a technique once used by a guardian of skies far broader than this one.
spell.apprenticecodex.lethal_assault.gui: Summons a magical rifle and fires a burst. It self-destructs after one firing sequence, but is specialized for handling built around that limitation.
spell.apprenticecodex.dual_acrobat.guide: Summons two magical SMGs and charges ammo by spinning them around you. Release to spray fire forward based on the charge.
spell.apprenticecodex.artisan_smash.guid: Summons a magical grenade launcher and fires an explosive shell, blasting a wide area where it lands. The blast does not destroy items or terrain, but it can hit you.
spell.apprenticecodex.totem_of_permafros: Summons and places a totem strongly imbued with ice magic, attacking the area around it with cold for a short time. The chill attempts to restrict targets' movement. While wearing the Greater Conjurer's Talisman, manually dismissing the totem does not trigger cooldown.
spell.apprenticecodex.field_overseer.gui: Summons an autonomous staff to watch over the area, striking nearby enemies with lightning magic. The staff prioritizes enemies with higher health. The caster's maximum mana at the time of summoning becomes the staff's mana capacity, and it consumes its stored mana when attacking. Move close enough to replenish the staff's mana automatically.
spell.apprenticecodex.servant_gaze.guide: Summons a staff that follows you and fires projectiles of pure magic at nearby enemies. The staff prioritizes enemies with higher health. It has no time limit, but consumes the caster's mana when attacking.
